title: Appendix: Navier–Stokes connections to vacuum gravity
introduction: Two appendix lessons to the forced Navier–Stokes blowup argument. The first encodes smooth compact incompressible velocity snapshots in exact gravitational constraint data and recovers the velocity. The second derives a separate linear gravitational shear model with a Navier–Stokes limit. These connections do not establish a gravitational singularity or a gravitational continuation through fluid blowup.
